tour.title: Tổng Quan Dự Án (Project Overview)
tour.description: Bắt đầu từ AGENTS.md gốc — tài liệu hướng dẫn chính cho AI agents và developers. Tìm hiểu cấu trúc monorepo: backend/ (ASP.NET Core 10 clean architecture), frontend/ (React 19 + Vite), frontend-admin/ (React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Zustand). Nắm các quy ước: API envelope, UI tiếng Việt, bun làm package manager, Conventional Commits. Xem backend/AGENTS.md để hiểu kiến trúc 4 lớp: Api -> Application -> Domain -> Infrastructure.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point — Program.cs & DI Pipeline
tour.description: Điểm khởi đầu của backend API. Program.cs đăng ký tất cả services. ServiceRegistration.cs — nơi tập trung toàn bộ DI: Npgsql database, JWT auth với role policies, repository & service interfaces, S3/AWS storage, SMTP email, Google/Zalo OAuth, Vertex AI cho try-on và stylist chat. Middleware pipeline: ExceptionHandlingMiddleware, CORS, Auth, Authorization, Controllers.

tour.title: Frontend Entry Point — main.tsx & App.tsx
tour.description: Điểm khởi đầu của SPA khách hàng. main.tsx mount React app với BrowserRouter, AuthProvider, ToastProvider. App.tsx định nghĩa 12 routes: Home, Collection, Products, Accessories, AI Try-On, Cart, Login, Account, OAuth callbacks, Reset Password, 404. client.ts: core HTTP client với API_BASE_URL routing theo region, request<T>() generic, auth cookie handling, error i18n.

tour.title: Domain Model — 23+ Entities với EF Core
tour.description: Tầng Domain: 23+ entities. Key: User (core với 10+ nav collections), UserAccount (OAuth/local), Product + Variant + Image + StyleProfile (catalog), Cart + CartItem (giỏ hàng), Order + OrderItem + Payment + Shipment (đơn hàng), ChatThread + ChatMessage + ChatThreadMemory (AI chat), Role, Review, MeasurementProfile, ProductAiAsset, ProductPairing, StyleScenario, UserAddress. BaseEntity: Id(Guid), CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, soft delete.

tour.title: API Response Envelope & Public Controllers
tour.description: Moi API response tuan theo envelope: ApiResponse<T> = { success, message, data, errors, timestamp }. ApiResponseFactory: static methods Ok, Created, BadRequest, NotFound, Unauthorized, Forbidden, Conflict, Error. Controllers chinh: AuthController (register/login/OAuth/refresh/logout/verify/reset, 11 endpoints), ProductsController (danh sach + loc + slug detail), AiTryOnController (catalog + generate), ChatController (SSE streaming), CheckoutController, UserCartController, UserOrderController, UserAddressController.

tour.title: Authentication & Authorization Flow
tour.description: AuthService: register, login (credentials + Google + Zalo), email verification, password reset, session management. JwtTokenService: HMAC-SHA256 access tokens + roles. RefreshTokenService: 48-byte random refresh tokens, HMACSHA256 hash. Pbkdf2PasswordHasher: PBKDF2-SHA256 100K iterations. GoogleOAuthService + ZaloOAuthService: OAuth code exchange. Frontend: AuthContext quan ly auth state + bootstrapSession + OAuth redirects. ProtectedRoute bao ve route. HttpOnly cookies cho refresh token.

tour.title: Product Catalog -- Tu API den UI
tour.description: ProductsController: danh sach phan trang voi filter (category, status, search) + detail theo slug kem variants + images. Frontend: ProductsPage hien thi grid san pham voi ProductCard components. Header voi category menu tu API. MaterialSection, ProductSection components. Animation: framer-motion presets tu utils/motion.ts. CategoriesController: flat list + header tree cho navigation.

tour.title: Cart & Checkout Flow
tour.description: Cart entity (unique per user), CartItem (variant + quantity). CartService: get/create cart, add/update/remove items, clear. Frontend CartPage: CartItem, CartSummary, CustomerNotes. Checkout: CheckoutService transaction (validate payment, resolve address, check stock, create Order+OrderItems+Payment, invoice email). UserOrderController: lich su don hang. Cart API dispatch custom event aodai:cart-updated.

tour.title: AI Try-On & AI Stylist Chat
tour.description: AI Try-On: AiTryOnController (GET catalog, POST generate multipart FormData, guest key). VertexAiTryOnService: goi anh len Vertex AI Gemini, extract base64 image tu streaming response. ConcurrencyLimitedAiTryOnService decorator voi SemaphoreSlim. Frontend AiTryonPage: 3-step flow (upload anh -> chon ao dai -> phu kien -> generate). AI Stylist Chat: StylistChatService orchestrator (thread CRUD, intent classification, catalog styling, try-on). SSE streaming qua ChatController. IntentClassifier: 10 intents, Gemini + rule-based fallback. ThreadMemoryService: JSONB state.

tour.title: Admin Panel -- Quan Ly Toan Dien
tour.description: Admin panel (frontend-admin/): React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Zustand 5 + shadcn/ui-inspired components. AdminLayout: sidebar navigation (San pham, Danh muc, Nguoi dung, Vai tro, Media). Auth: AdminRoute guard + LoginPage. Zustand stores: useProductStore, useCategoryStore, useUserStore, useRoleStore, useAuthStore. ProductListPage: table, search, status filter, pagination. ProductFormPage: form create/edit product. Backend admin controllers: AdminProductsController (CRUD + status toggle + soft delete + restore + image visibility), AdminCategoriesController, AdminUsersController, AdminRolesController, AdminMediaController.

tour.title: Database -- Migrations & DbContext
tour.description: EF Core 10 + PostgreSQL (Npgsql). Migration InitGuid: tao ENUMs + 30+ tables. Subsequent migrations: AddSoftDelete (soft-delete columns + rebuild unique indexes), AddUserGeneratedImages, AddProductImageVisibility (is_public + public_object_key), AddProductIsPublic. AppDbContextModelSnapshot: EF Core model snapshot tong hop. Repository pattern: IProductRepository, ICategoryRepository, ICartRepository, IUserProfileRepository. Moi repo co implementation trong Infrastructure/Data/Repositories.

tour.title: CI/CD Pipeline -- Multi-Region Deployment
tour.description: GitHub Actions deploy-dev.yml: build + deploy len 2 regions (HK1 + US1). Jobs: build-frontend-hk1/us1 (Bun build SPA voi region-specific env vars), build-admin-hk1/us1 (admin SPA), build-backend (dotnet publish shared across regions). Deploy jobs: SSH + rsync artifacts len VPS, Cloudflare Tunnel setup, .NET runtime install, runtime-env.sh config, PM2 process management (stop/start/reload). Backend chay duoi PM2, frontend served qua Vite preview. Luu y: CI chua chay dotnet test hoac lint.
